assets.title: 好奇的小章鱼
assets.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand / character illustration.
Create ONE original character-based app icon for a friendly personal reading, learning and daily-planning desktop app. The user explicitly wants a fun, memorable little character with personality. Fresh visual direction: modern 2D illustrated mascot branding, bold elegant curves, expressive asymmetric pose, strong silhouette, small-size readability. Think a beautifully art-directed independent app character, appealing to university students and adults, friendly but not babyish.
Composition: square full-bleed opaque colored background; one large central mascot, occupying about 75% of width, head/face and body clearly readable at 32px. Limited palette, broad flat color shapes with only very restrained cel shading, confident dark outline of consistent weight, clean graphic edges. It must be an actual finished single icon, not a sticker sheet, not a mockup or a scene. No text, no letters, no names, no watermark.
Avoid: photoreal fur, realistic materials, 3D clay rendering, knitted/fabric textures, watercolor, paper craft, folded-paper logos, beige journal aesthetic, generic smiling blobs, giant anime eyes, crowded props, tiny decorative marks, graduation caps, spectacles as a shortcut for intelligence, existing famous mascot designs.
Character A: an ORIGINAL little ink-violet octopus, squat and clever, with a large softly squared domed head, a small off-center apricot forehead spot, two simple bright ivory oval eyes looking slightly upward, a short knowing half-smile. Five or six broad rounded tentacle shapes only, not a tangle; one tentacle curls upward to gently touch its own cheek as if thinking, another holds ONE very small blank coral bookmark card near the body. Confident curious personality, slight mischievous tilt, no suction-cup details. Deep purple (#51458F), pale lilac accents, coral bookmark; clean fresh mint-turquoise background (#91D5C4). Dark plum outlines. Strong compact silhouette, lively pose, the character feels like a thoughtful companion who can help with several little tasks. Keep the face unmistakably readable and the outline iconic.
